# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VWAP_HOLD

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When SPY gaps up but fails to hold above VWAP in the first half‑hour, the gap tends to fade, offering a short opportunity. This fade occurs because the initial buying pressure exhausts and sellers step in, pulling price back to VWAP and below.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If today's open > prior day's close + 0.3% (gap up) and price crosses below VWAP within the first 30 minutes (09:30‑10:00 ET) and closes below VWAP with a bearish candle (close < open), enter short at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the high of the gap bar (or opening range high). Target set at 1.5R from entry. After hitting target, trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR×3). Only consider setups when VIX < 20 (to avoid panic‑driven gaps) and during 09:30‑10:00 ET; ignore gap‑down scenarios.
